text='''def transform(grid):
    # Remove isolated marker cells. Markers inside a solid colored object are
    # assimilated into that object; markers outside objects become background.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    from collections import Counter, deque
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if (r,c) in seen:
                continue
            color = grid[r][c]
            q = [(r,c)]
            seen.add((r,c))
            for y,x in q:
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    yy,xx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx]==color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            if len(q)==1 and color != bg:
                y,x=q[0]
                neighbors=[grid[yy][xx] for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)) if 0<=(yy:=y+dy)<h and 0<=(xx:=x+dx)<w and grid[yy][xx]!=color]
                counts=Counter(neighbors)
                out[y][x]=counts.most_common(1)[0][0] if counts and counts.most_common(1)[0][1]>=2 else bg
    return out
'''
